subject: Pilot Scope, Decision Timeline & Action Owners (Recap)
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@novushealth.com>, Devon Lee <devon.lee@novushealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot Scope, Decision Timeline & Action Owners (Recap)

Hi Samira / Devon —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap of what we discussed and the proposed mutual action plan so everyone has a single source of truth. If anything below is off, flag it and I’ll update the MAP immediately.

Key pain & goals (what you told us)
- Production latency spikes when you batch overnight analytics; current endpoint times out on 1–2M token jobs.
- Need private deployment (VPC) and audit logs for a SOC-2 adjacent timeline.
- Goal: replace current inference endpoints for the triage pipeline, reduce per-token cost by 30–40% and guarantee < 250ms p90 for single-turn inference by pilot end.

Proposed pilot scope
1) Workloads: triage pipeline subset — 3 models (classification, entity extraction, reranker), up to 2M tokens/day.
2) Environment: Redwood Private (VPC) in us-west-2; redacted sample data only.
3) Success criteria: cost-per-1000 tokens <= $X (we'll finalize with Aditya after sizing), p90 latency < 250ms for single-turn, integration smoke tests green.

Milestones & owners (dates are target; ask: please confirm stakeholder availability)
- M1 (Week 0–1): Kickoff & NDA/PO on file — Owner: Samira (Novus procurement) — Target: Oct 26
- M2 (Week 1–2): Environment access + sample data handoff — Owner: Devon (Engineering) — Target: Nov 2
- M3 (Week 2–4): Pilot deployment + baseline benchmarks — Owner: Aditya Rao (Redwood SE) — Target: Nov 16
- M4 (Week 5–6): Integration test & quality check — Owner: Monica Patel (Redwood CS) — Target: Nov 30
- M5 (Week 7): Pilot review & expansion decision — Owner: Samira (Novus Product) — Target: Dec 7

Decision process & signoffs
- Novus Product (Samira): final go/no-go for expansion.
- Novus Procurement (PO): purchase order required ahead of M1 completion.
- Redwood: technical acceptance based on success criteria above.

Immediate asks (for this week)
- Samira: confirm procurement timeline and provide PO template if available.
- Devon: share a sanitized sample (1–2 files) and IAM contacts for VPC setup.
- Aditya/Monica: prepare a short SOW and MAP doc; sharing first draft by EOD Wed.

Attachments: Novus_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), Redwood_SOW_draft_v0.3.pdf (SOW stub).

Thanks — I’ll schedule a 30-min sync for next Tue (Oct 26) if that works for everyone.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0193

From: Devon Lee <devon.lee@novushealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Samira Khan <samira.k@novushealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot Scope, Decision Timeline & Action Owners (Recap)

Thanks Jasmine — this looks good and captures our discussion. Couple of clarifications:

- Procurement: we can get a PO out but need final numbers and a short SOW to attach. Can Aditya confirm estimated monthly spend range based on the workload above?
- Data handoff: I can provide a sanitized sample by Friday (Oct 23). I will send the S3 link and a service account for VPC peering.
- Timeline: Nov 16 for baseline benchmarks looks fine, but we need the pilot review earlier if possible — can we aim to have a preliminary review on Dec 3 instead of Dec 7? That helps align with our Q4 planning.

I’m copying our security lead (not on this thread yet) in a separate email with the SOC-2 checklist.

—Devon
Devon Lee
Senior Engineering Manager, Novus Health
devon.lee@novushealth.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@novushealth.com>, Devon Lee <devon.lee@novushealth.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot Scope, Decision Timeline & Action Owners (Recap)

Hi all —

Thanks for the fast replies. Quick notes from the SE side:
- Cost estimate: for the pilot footprint described (3 models, up to 2M tokens/day, private VPC), we estimate $6k–$9k/month depending on batching/quantization choices. I’ll include a sensitivity table in the SOW.
- Work to do before M3: sample data validation (Devon), network CID ranges for peering (Devon), list of model variants you want to test (Samira/Product).
- I’ve attached a lightweight MAP (Novus_MAP_v1.xlsx) with checkpoints and acceptance criteria. Monica and I will update the SOW draft with the sensitivity table and a brief runbook for rollback.

Action: Monica and I will send the SOW v0.4 and updated MAP by EOD Thu (Oct 22).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if we need to tighten dates.

-Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Appreciate the clear recap. Confirming:
- Procurement: I’ll aim to have a PO template and initial approval routed by Oct 28.
- Data: Devon will share the sanitized sample this week.
- Timeline: we can target the preliminary review on Dec 3 as requested. If any of the milestone dates shift by more than 3 business days, please flag immediately.

We’re good to proceed with the MAP as drafted — please send the updated SOW and I’ll loop in procurement once the final numbers are available.

Samira Khan
